lines: Interface: its build agent finished it and it is merged here at 16:18 (Tab follows the order on screen; the globe sits a little higher on the wide screens so the controls clear the base; the phone held sideways has its own row; a plain line shows when WebGL2 is missing; film links open on any season, which failed on spring until 16:04). Not pushed yet: the ten links of the hostcheck, the controls check and a still's hash are running on the merge first.
App sheets with plain labels landed at 16:05: a shake, a stir, a drag and a jump can now be drawn through the app's own path for the motion critic.
Next: the eight keys again on the merged commit, a publish, then Round 18, the first round on the whole globe. The six polish builders report between 17:10 and 17:15.
phase 5: 2.13 h used of its 12.00 h box
allowance (before the review, continuation 1): 2.13 h used of 12.00 h allowed

pictures.caption: The wide screen with its controls, winter (draft tier, the finished interface): season marks at the left, Shake in the middle, sound at the right, all clear of the globe and its base
The wide screen, fall: the same row sits on the dark surface under the base, 8.4 percent of the screen's height clear of it
The phone in spring and the tablet in summer: the marks in a row above Shake on the phone, the sound control on its own dark disc
The sheet the critic of the whole gets in Round 18: the four seasons at rest, tiles numbered 1 to 4 with no season named
